scope.owner: GPL flight-net::embedded; same Bevy resource adapter

contract.limit_source: flight-net::MAX_COMMANDS_PER_INPUT, also enforced by server payload validation
contract.counted: whole coalesced packet: every ordered event variant plus remaining Pause/SetWarp state votes
contract.overflow: reject without replacing accepted pending input; public link closes/refuses further intent; oversized caller list refused before cloning
contract.ordering: state votes coalesce, ordered events stay FIFO
contract.observed_io_failure: reader EOF/read/framing error or writer encode/write error closes existing mailbox and wakes idle writer
contract.api: is_closed observes worker/mailbox closure; send_input true means queued, not acknowledged
contract.not_established: heartbeat, stalled-peer detection without a host deadline, reconnect, joined-worker shutdown, stronger snapshot/Welcome validation or native viewer server adoption

regressions.count_and_transaction: 62 valid fleet Separate events plus two state votes fit; replacing votes at capacity fits; an additional event rejects transactionally and preserves previous tick/commands
regressions.reader_eof: child closes stdout but remains alive; input side closes and later sends fail; Drop kills/reaps child
regressions.broken_writer: child consumes Hello, emits Welcome, closes stdin and keeps stdout open while alive; write failure closes mailbox; Drop kills/reaps child
regressions.oversized_caller: 65-command caller packet closes link without queuing that packet
regressions.existing: ten transport inbox/mailbox/interpolation/startup/successful-drop tests retained; old legacy-edge bound regression now uses shared protocol limit

stress.boundary: fixture stress, not a throughput benchmark or a proof of all possible scheduling interleavings

legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: audio device warnings, no audio verification; capture wall-time is not a fixed simulation epoch or visual-parity/acceptance evidence

limitations: A peer can remain alive with open pipes and stop producing snapshots: host deadlines/heartbeat remain necessary.
Input queue acceptance is not remote acknowledgement or guaranteed delivery after disconnect.
The cap bounds command count, not arbitrary caller-owned heap data; semantic payload validation and frame-byte limits remain existing protocol/producer responsibilities.
Native viewer networking/fleets/prediction, visual parity and remaining Bevy displacement are not established by this fix.
